method: Read-only source inspection, JSON parsing and Python AST literal extraction; no upstream imports or execution
scope: Pinned inventory subsets and public adapter contracts; not exhaustive semantic deduplication or live verification

enginewire.caveat: Canonical records and folded aliases are not comparable public tool counts; preserve selectors and native availability/policy gates.

ue-mcp.caveat: Recorded subsets can overlap and omit local/extension actions. Default micro public gateway is tools; live editor registration gates availability.

unrealagentplayer.extraction: ast.parse plus ast.literal_eval of Tool name/description/inputSchema keywords
unrealagentplayer.caveat: Static listing does not guarantee platform, rendering, PIE or runtime availability. Text JSON can contain operation failure.

claireon.caveat: Internal catalog names are not direct MCP tools; no full internal count/schema extraction claimed. Reviewed typed wrapper required.

hayba.extraction: JSON parsing; candidate filter agent_callable === true && has_ts_wrapper === false
hayba.caveat: Counts are partial, before collisions and dynamic packs. No total public count established. via:ts can internally fall through to legacy if typed schema is absent.

ivan-unreal-mcp.caveat: Family source inspection excludes system/extensions; external MCP server is not in repo; full schemas not extracted. Restricted RQL/Code-Exec source not copied.
